regions.name: startup
regions.evidence: PS-X startup clears BSS, establishes stack and GP, runs constructor tables, and transfers control to the game entry routine.

regions.name: game
regions.evidence: Game and engine code begins at Main_Init and ends before the first SN/Psy-Q host-I/O break wrapper.

regions.name: sdk
regions.evidence: SN host-I/O wrappers followed by Sony runtime, hardware, GTE, libc, memory-card, CD, GPU, SPU, and MDEC library code through the end of resident text.
